title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.07025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless

translated_title: LowRAM：面向测试时可组合KV缓存压缩的低秩键与摊销值方法
translated_abstract: 自回归解码依赖于KV缓存，其内存占用随上下文长度线性增长，限制了批处理大小和吞吐量。现有的训练后方法利用令牌、层和特征维度之间的冗余性，或采用降低数值精度的手段。我们识别出一个互补的维度：在每个注意力头内部，值在很大程度上可以从其对应的键中预测出来。我们通过值缓存摊销来利用这一特性，在测试时为每个注意力头拟合一个轻量级预测器，并仅为其重构效果最差的令牌存储残差，从而实现4倍近无损的值缓存压缩。该预测器可以通过元学习进行初始化以大幅降低预填充开销，也可以在允许一次性成本的场景（如多查询推理）中从头拟合。我们将值摊销与跨层低秩键压缩相结合，构建出LowRAM——一种保持接近无损的非对称压缩流水线。
tldr: 该论文提出LowRAM方法，利用注意力头内“值可由键预测”的特性，在测试时通过值缓存摊销（仅存储重构最差令牌的残差，实现4倍近无损压缩），并结合跨层低秩键压缩，构建出接近无损的可组合KV缓存压缩流水线。
en_tdlr: LowRAM exploits the predictability of values from keys within each attention head via test-time value amortisation (4× near-lossless compression by storing residuals only for worst-reconstructed tokens), combined with cross-layer low-rank key compression, to achieve a composable and near-lossless KV cache compression pipeline.
